The system consists of hundreds of glowing points that drift gently through space using Perlin noise for natural movement, connected by dynamic lines that shimmer and fade in response to their distance and the passage of time. The visualization captures the idea of a fragile, living network where connections occasionally break and reform, creating moments of vulnerability within the larger pattern.
